correctness.rationale: The normalized recursive adjacent sums are exactly the binomial-window matrices B_k. The globally unique all-equal spacing minimizer is enforced by the first Moran term. The displayed Taylor expansion gives the exact positive definite Hessian Q_m; the Dirichlet(1^m) density is (m-1)! and ellipsoid volume gives the sharp all-m coefficient. The m=2 known result and the m=3 rational determinant were reconstructed; 453 finite exact/numerical diagnostics passed. No finite experiment replaces the analytic arbitrary-m proof.

value.rationale: The original goodness-of-fit test is calibrated numerically except for one observation; its natural regularity endpoint has a sharp, sample-size-dependent probability coefficient computable without simulation for every fixed n. The explicit all-recursion rational Hessian yields the exact n/2 exponent and a strict nontrivial comparison to Moran, including factor 2/sqrt(5) at two observations. This is motivated finite-size structural calibration, not an arbitrary slice or repackaged known table; no general large-sample or finite-threshold accuracy claim is made.
